شاهد مستند: متن رسمی؛ سازگاری نسخه باید بررسی شود.

بخش منبع:

```text
`st.dataframe` UI features
```

نسخهٔ منبع:

```text
695e6ce2fb1b23afc6df66b40420ab0013ad72fd
```

متن شاهد:

```text
`st.dataframe` provides additional functionality by using [glide-data-grid](https://github.com/glideapps/glide-data-grid) under the hood:
```

نشانی منبع:

```text
https://github.com/streamlit/docs/blob/695e6ce2fb1b23afc6df66b40420ab0013ad72fd/content/develop/concepts/app-design/dataframes.md
```

محدودیت: بر اساس شواهد موجود، دکمه‌های نوار ابزار در `st.dataframe` کوچکتر از حداقل اندازه توصیه شده توسط WCAG 2.2 هستند که منجر به رد شدن آزمون استاندارد `target-size` می‌شود. اصلاح این اندازه به 24 پیکسل یا افزایش فاصله می‌تواند بهبود دسترس‌پذیری را تضمین کند.

وضعیت: رفع مشکل تأیید نشده است؛ ثبت پاسخ فقط پس از تأیید نگه‌دارنده انجام می‌شود.

summary.problem:
`st.dataframe` toolbar buttons are 22.4px, below the WCAG 2.2 24px minimum target size (axe `target-size`)

### Checklist
- [x] I have searched the existing issues for similar issues.
- [x] I added a very descriptive title to this issue.
- [x] I have provided sufficient information below to help reproduce this issue.

### Summary
The hover toolbar that `st.dataframe` draws (Show/hide columns, Download as CSV, Search, Fullscreen)
renders each button at 22.4 x 22.4 CSS px, and the buttons sit next to each other, so axe-core's
`target-size` rule (impact: serious, WCAG 2.2 AA, SC 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum)) fails. Cause:
`StyledElementToolbarButton` in `frontend/lib/src/components/shared/BaseButton/styled-components.ts`
(1.64.0, line ~524) sets `padding: theme.spacing.twoXS` and `minHeight: "unset"` around a small icon.

### Reproducible Code Example
Same app as above (the `st.dataframe` line is enough).

### Steps To Reproduce
1. `streamlit run app.py`
2. Hover the dataframe so the toolbar appears.
3. Run axe-core 4.13 with the `wcag22aa` tag.

### Expected Behavior
Each toolbar button is at least 24 x 24 CSS px (or spaced so a 24px circle around each does not overlap
another target).

### Current Behavior
```
target-size (serious, wcag22aa, wcag258) — 4 nodes
<button kind="elementToolbar" data-testid="stBaseButton-elementToolbar" aria-label="Show/hide columns" class="st-emotion-cache-18ac3gt eqzt73c20">
  Target has insufficient size (22.4px by 22.4px, should be at least 24px by 24px)
<button ... aria-label="Download as CSV" ...>   (same)
<button ... aria-label="Search" ...>            (same)
<button ... aria-label="Fullscreen" ...>        (same)
```

### Suggested fix
Give `StyledElementToolbarButton` `minWidth: "1.5rem"` and `minHeight: "1.5rem"` (24px) instead of
`minHeight: "unset"`, or raise the padding one step. The toolbar is already an overlay above the element,
so the extra 1.6px per button does not move page layout. The same styled button is used by other element
toolbars (charts, `st.data_editor`), which would all pass with the one change.

In the same minimal app, axe also reports `target-size` on the `st.date_input` month/day spinbutton
segments (17.9 x 19.6px); that may deserve its own look but is secondary.

### Is this a regression?
- [ ] Yes, this used to work in a previous version.
- [x] No.

### Debug info
- Streamlit version: 1.64.0 (latest)
- Python version: 3.12
- OS: Linux (CI) and Windows 11
- Browser: Chromium (Playwright bundled)
-
